title: Rectilinear
summary: RECTILIN'EAR, a. [L. rectus, right, and linea, line.] Right lined; consisting of a right line or of right lines; straight; as a rectilinear figure or course; a rectilinear side or way.

inlines.v: RECTILIN'EAR, a. [L. rectus, right, and linea, line.] Right lined; consisting of a right line or of right lines; straight; as a rectilinear figure or course; a rectilinear side or way.
